shortDescription: Anthropic co-founder and CEO proposed coordinating frontier AI companies in democratic countries to establish shared safety standards. According to Odaily, the proposal calls for common safety standards among these companies.

title: Anthropic CEO Proposes Coordinated Safety Standards for Frontier AI Companies in Democratic Countries
